say:1:1530347001:1.source_cn: 你不知道吗？呼临城发洪水了！

say:2:1530347002:1.text: If I hadn't moved fast, the flood would've taken me as well!
say:2:1530347002:1.source_cn: 要不是我反应还算快，腿脚也不慢，恐怕也要被暴雨冲走了！
say:2:1530347002:1.male: If I hadn't moved fast, the flood would've taken me as well!
say:2:1530347002:1.female: If I hadn't moved fast, the flood would've taken me as well!

say:3:1530347003:1.text: This place is so weird. I'm getting out of here.
say:3:1530347003:1.source_cn: 这地方实在太古怪了，我得赶紧离开。
say:3:1530347003:1.male: This place is so weird. I'm getting out of here.
say:3:1530347003:1.female: This place is so weird. I'm getting out of here.
